kindHint.correction: What you corrected: in {{copilot}}’s answers, a correction comes before everything else.
kindHint.workspace_rule: A rule that holds for your whole company — every member sees it.
kindHint.sourced_observation: Something observed, with its source named.
kindHint.hypothesis: A lead to check: {{copilot}} uses it to shed light, never to decide.
kindHint.temporary_context: Context that only holds for a while.
kindHint.goal: What you're aiming for — {{copilot}} uses it to steer its suggestions.

scopeWho.user: Visible to you only: your colleagues don't see it, and {{copilot}} only uses it for you.
scopeWho.workspace: Visible to every member of your workspace: {{copilot}} uses it for each of them.
scopeWho.business_unit: Visible to the members of {{name}}: {{copilot}} uses it for them, and for nobody else in your workspace.
scopeWho.conversation: Used in this thread only, never listed under Knowledge. Kept for as long as the conversation exists.

memoryLedger.title: What {{copilot}} keeps in mind
memoryLedger.subtitle: Everything {{copilot}} retains, in plain words. Any line can be forgotten in one click — and a forgotten line also leaves the context she re-reads.
memoryLedger.unreadable: This layer could not be read. That is not “no lines”: what it holds stays unknown until the next load.
memoryLedger.unavailable: Memory could not be read. Nothing is shown because nothing was read — not because {{copilot}} retains nothing.

reply.title: How {{copilot}} answers you
reply.intro: These settings change the form of her answers, never the substance: what she doesn't know, she still says. A request in your message ("go into detail", "in one sentence") comes first.
reply.defaultHint: {{copilot}} fits the answer to each question
reply.unreadable: Your answer settings couldn't be read. That doesn't make them "default": they stay unknown until the next load.

messageApproach.title: Your approach in your messages
messageApproach.intro: The direct approach announces what you offer and asks one question to qualify the need, with no signal or article added. Once saved, it applies to your next messages; an objective chosen in the composer always comes first. You can remove it at any time.
messageApproach.label: Message approach
messageApproach.defaultHint: Each message follows the objective you choose
messageApproach.unreadable: Your approach setting could not be read. That does not mean "default": it stays unknown until the next load.

protectedTime.title: Your protected time
protectedTime.intro: The hours when you can actually work. Without them, {{copilot}} only counts the gaps between two meetings — never the time before the first one or after the last.
protectedTime.invalidRange: The end time must be after the start time.

agendaPreferences.title: Your agenda preferences
agendaPreferences.intro: How long it takes you to open a case, and how many slots you always want kept in reserve. {{copilot}} also keeps that reserve free when organising your day. Without them, {{copilot}} counts capacity with the same defaults for everyone.
agendaPreferences.invalidDuration: The duration per case must be between 15 and 240 minutes.
agendaPreferences.invalidReserve: The reserve must be between 0 and 10 slots.

personalPreferences.title: Personal preferences
personalPreferences.description: How you like to work: the preferences you pinned for yourself, and the free-form settings {{copilot}} re-reads on every exchange. Nobody else sees them.

personalObjectives.title: Personal goals
personalObjectives.description: What you are aiming for, pinned for you alone: {{copilot}} uses it for you, never for a colleague.
personalObjectives.declared: Your goal and your target come from your profile questionnaire. They are not forgotten from here: they are corrected where you entered them.

esnRules.title: Company rules
esnRules.description: What applies to your whole company: every member sees it, and {{copilot}} uses it for each of them.
esnRules.empty: No rule shared with your company.

accountContext.title: Account context
accountContext.description: What only applies to one account.
accountContext.empty: Nothing is kept about a specific account.

corrections.title: Field corrections
corrections.description: What you corrected in the field: in {{copilot}}'s answers, a correction comes before everything else, even more recent data.

referenceDocuments.title: Reference documents
referenceDocuments.description: Memory keeps no documents. The ones {{copilot}} consults live in your knowledge base: for every question asked in the chat, she looks there for the useful passages.

temporary.title: Temporary items
temporary.description: What only applies until a date. Once expired, the item stays here with its date, and {{copilot}} no longer uses it.

teamContext.title: My team's context
teamContext.description: What only applies to your team or business unit — neither the whole company nor a single account.
teamContext.empty: Nothing is kept about your team.

source.copilotMine: Kept from an answer by {{copilot}}, saved by you
source.copilotBy: Kept from an answer by {{copilot}}, saved by {{name}}
source.analysisMine: From a dossier, saved by you

why.correction: Why: it is a correction — {{copilot}} puts it before everything else, even more recent data.
why.copilotNote: Why: it is a note from {{copilot}} that nobody confirmed — it informs her answers without settling anything. Check it.
why.declared: Why: a person declared it, nothing was inferred — {{copilot}} gives it priority.
why.confirmedNote: Why: a person reviewed and corrected it — {{copilot}} treats it as a declared fact.
why.hypothesis: Why: it is a hypothesis to check — {{copilot}} uses it to shed light, it does not decide with it.

surfaces.label: Where {{copilot}} uses it:
surfaces.externalAssistant: the answers of your external AI assistant, if it is connected
surfaces.otherAccount: On another account, {{copilot}} does not use it.
surfaces.unused: Not used by {{copilot}} today: its deadline has passed.

consultations.count_other: Consulted by {{copilot}} in {{count}} answers, most recently on {{date}}
consultations.neverExpired: Never consulted by {{copilot}} before its deadline
consultations.openAria: Open the conversation where {{copilot}} last consulted “{{text}}”

edit.label: Item text
edit.updateFailed: The change could not be saved

confirm.aria: Confirm as a fact, without changing the text: {{text}}

history.unavailable: The history could not be read. Nothing is shown because nothing was read — not because nothing changed.

facts.title: What you pinned
facts.description: Facts, preferences and corrections pinned by hand or kept from an answer. Each one is for you only or for your whole company — the badge says which, and you can change it on what you pinned.

preferences.title: How you like to work
preferences.description: The free-form settings {{copilot}} re-reads on every exchange. Personal: nobody else sees them.

conversations.title: The thread of your exchanges
conversations.description: A rolling summary: two excerpts per exchange, what you wrote and what {{copilot}} answered. This is the exact text she re-reads on your next message.

refusals.title: What you turned down
refusals.description: What {{copilot}} offered and what you did with it. This is what stops her offering the same thing again.
refusals.empty: No suggestion in the recent past.

identity.title: What {{copilot}} knows about you
identity.description: What you declared about your role and the way you sell. {{copilot}} reads it back on every exchange — it sets her tone and how much advice she gives.
identity.empty: Nothing declared: {{copilot}} knows nothing about you beyond what you write to her.
identity.declared: You wrote these lines yourself. They are not forgotten here: they are corrected where you entered them.

workspace.title: What {{copilot}} knows about your company
workspace.description: Your company profile, exactly as it goes into {{copilot}}'s context on every exchange. Shared: your colleagues read the same lines.
workspace.empty: No profile filled in: {{copilot}} reasons without knowing anything about your company.
workspace.declared: This profile is entered in settings. It is not forgotten from this screen: erasing it here would wipe the whole workspace's configuration.

detail.skipEnrichmentCostConfirmation: Enrich one contact without asking about the cost again

never.title: What {{copilot}} never memorises
never.messageBodies: The content of your messages. It is kept in your activity log, which is yours — it is never handed to {{copilot}}, nor to a colleague.
never.otherWorkspace: Data from another workspace. Every read carries your workspace's scope, with no exception.
never.colleagueOutOfScope: Anything belonging to a colleague outside your scope. Your preferences and your refusals are personal.
never.deletedByUser: Anything you forgot. A forgotten line leaves the screen AND the context {{copilot}} re-reads: it is archived, never re-read again — here we archive, we do not destroy.
never.accidentalSecret: A secret shared by mistake. Remove it here: {{copilot}} stops re-reading it from the next message on.

scope.workspace: Now shared with your whole company

toast.scopeFailed: Could not change who sees it

forgetAll.title: Forget everything?
forgetAll.goes: What is permanently deleted: the facts YOU pinned, your preferences, the summary of all your exchanges with {{copilot}}, the trace of her proposals, and your feedback on {{copilot}}'s replies (in this workspace).
forgetAll.stays: What stays: facts pinned by your colleagues — they are not yours — plus your profile and your company's, which are corrected in settings; and the corrections you applied to an account's file stay, for the team.
forgetAll.confirmationsStay: Your confirmations on the team's notes stay visible.
forgetAll.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Nothing will bring these lines back.
forgetAll.partial: Part of it could not be erased: {{layers}}. Those lines are still there — try again.

add.title: Add to my memory
add.description: What you write here is kept for you alone and joins {{copilot}}’s context. You can remove it at any time.
add.note: This addition is deliberate. It changes neither your business, your expertise, nor an account’s facts. A piece of news is not turned into a confirmed need.

messageLibrary.errorState: The library could not be read.

blocked.review: To review before it can be offered.
